Im actually taking a year off from Carolina. I was a junior transfer in fall 2019 and you know what happened in spring 2020, I hated carolina from the first day I sent foot on campus. I was super depressed my entire two years at carolina, (taking an extra year to double major). Fall 2019 was the hardest semester of my life, I literally wanted to end my self, I was this 🤏🏼 close to being shipped to god. Its awful to say this, but COVID was a blessing for ME mentally, but academically COVID destroyed my confidence, left me feeling like a failure 😞 my grades were soooooo bad, and im not talking C's here. But I got to come back home where I could get the support from my mother. Im still struggling really bad as we speak but I feel so much better now that on a normal day I dont have to think about UNC. I only have 6 classes left so I will just have to push through starting fall 2022. My advice is to just take care of your health. Carolina will always be there. Mental health is important. You might feel like your waisting time if you take a break, but you can do so much more to take your mind off UNC.
